messages:
Emma: Quick sync — I'm starting a sweep to migrate SDK snippets and inline examples to our new terminology. We'll switch the client param from `result` -> `response` and normalize the model identifier to `model_version` (API-level stays as-is). Opening 3 small PRs (py/js/go) so we can iterate quickly.

Devin: Thanks — are these only name changes or do we want to adjust example tone/length too?

Emma: Both. Primary goal is naming consistency. Secondary: make examples concise (one short example per language) and add a single expandable 'full example' for advanced usage. Tracking sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/placeholder (internal).

Mike: FYI the docs linter flagged a bunch of fenced-code issues: some snippets are missing language tags (it wants "```python" not just "```"), and MDX playground chokes on unescaped backticks. I'll paste failing job excerpt if useful.

Emma: Good catch — I'll fix the fences in the PRs. Example change I'm proposing: 
```
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
print(c.generate(response="Write a haiku about compilers", model_version="rwd-1"))
```
```
(This is the short example; full example will show streaming + error handling.)

Alina: Microcopy note: in UI strings use "model version" (two words) but in SDK/JSON fields use `model_version`. Also, on glossary: we agreed to prefer "prefetch" instead of "cache warming" earlier — that should be reflected in samples. @docs-bot, can you confirm?

docs-bot: Reminder: glossary policy v2 active. Preferred term: "prefetch". Related page: /glossary/prefetch. Automated link check found 12 broken links under /docs/samples/ — see the link-checker report in #eng-docs.

Sara: I'll port the Python snippet to JS + Go once PRs are open. Suggest we add a one-line note near examples clarifying "response" is the client param (not the raw API response). Also propose a short sentence about function-calling vs tool-calling naming to avoid confusion.

Devin: Labeling plan: each PR gets labels: `docs:migration`, `needs-glossary-review`, `needs-voice-approval`. Approvers: @Alina (voice), @Emma (author), plus one eng reviewer. Aim: 1 week review turnaround.

Mike: Small caution — don't rename API response fields in docs unless there's an API change. I saw a proposed change that suggested `choices` -> `items` in examples; let's not do that. Keep schema names identical to API.

Emma: Agreed. We'll only rename client-facing params in snippets and add an author note in PR description: "Renames in examples only; no API contract changes."

Alina: :thumbsup: I'll review the three PRs today for voice/terminology consistency. If anything feels risky, I'll file a tiny RFC and flag it in the PR.

Sara: Starting on the JS PR now @Emma — will include unit tests for the snippet where possible and run the link-checker locally before pushing. Ping me after you open.

Emma: Opening PRs now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4217 (python), https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4218 (js), https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4219 (go). Please review when you can. Plan to merge after voice + eng signoff. Target: EOD Fri.

Devin: ACK. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
